title: Release the complete model bundle, not a floating model name
description: Select a versioned candidate and exposure strategy. The lab binds quality, critical-slice behavior, runtime health, artifact identity, lineage, incident regressions, and rollback readiness to one release decision.

candidates.label: v42: balanced candidate
candidates.detail: Improves the target task, preserves the critical slice, and carries complete release evidence.

candidates.label: v43: aggregate winner
candidates.detail: The average improves, but a low-volume critical slice and online errors regress.

candidates.label: v44: unbound artifact
candidates.detail: Runtime numbers look healthy, but the candidate lacks a signed artifact and complete data-to-evaluator lineage.

strategies.label: Shadow comparison
strategies.detail: Mirror real requests, suppress candidate responses, and compare behavior without user exposure.

strategies.label: Bounded canary
strategies.detail: Serve a measured traffic slice with automatic stop and rollback thresholds.

strategies.label: Direct promotion
strategies.detail: Route all production traffic immediately; reserve this for exceptional low-risk changes with complete evidence.
